_doc: Batch m08 (medium creatures, sonnet generic pass): reptiles (lizards, monitors, snakes). Family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults. Same format as overrides.json.

smooth-snake/f:b1.note: whip of the coils is a lash; keyword snap is false (not a jaw), avoids bite twice

smooth-snake/f:u0.note: constricting coil squeeze: strand wrap (trip), differs from the slash lash

smooth-snake/f:u1.note: smooth scales slip away: sheen glint, differs from Hiss Feint puff

smooth-snake/f:u2.note: hiss breath mist; differs from Sleek Venom Feint drip

water-snake/f:b2.note: olive banded water-snake: banded ripples on the shield, differs from Tight Coil shield

water-snake/f:u3.note: reed weave: reed leaves, differs from the other evade puff-like pieces

tree-monitor/f:b1.note: long-tail coil whip cracks out as a lance; avoids two slashes

tree-monitor/f:u2.note: venom drip hangs as a thread from the branch; differs from Overhead Venom Dribble drip

tree-monitor/f:u3.note: drop from the canopy lands with a thud, not a shock zigzag

water-monitor/f:b2.note: dark swimmer scales glint wet; differs from Wallow Plate shield

water-monitor/f:u2.note: waterline shove pushes waves out; differs from Tail Sweep bash

night-adder/f:u1.note: quick fangs flicker as zigzag strikes; differs from Fang Strike thrust

night-adder/f:u2.note: night coil: coiled strand loops; differs from Zigzag Back Scales shield

tree-snake/f:b1.note: vine coil lash is a strand wrap; keyword vine would give leaf twice with Leaf Strike

tree-snake/f:u1.note: Leaf Strike is named for the leaf; mechanical poison drip already on Unseen Venom Jet

tree-snake/f:u2.note: bough cover: dappled light camouflage glints; differs from Branch Drape puff

tree-snake/f:u3.note: coil drop from above is a lunging strike, not a shock zigzag

spice-monitor/f:b1.note: sweeping tail knock: bash so it differs from Tail Whip slash

spice-monitor/f:b3.note: tasting the air: spice heat embers; ripple already on Fork Tongue

spice-monitor/f:u2.note: forked tongue flick ripples the air; no tag and no keyword, best guess

spice-monitor/f:u3.note: cinnamon cloud is a dust puff; differs from Spice Bite drip

komodo-pup/f:b2.note: crouched scales bristle low; differs from Dune Hide shield

komodo-pup/f:u0.note: pup tail trip knocks the foe over; differs from Ankle Sweep slash

komodo-pup/f:u3.note: low watch: eyes glint in the grass; three hold shields would repeat

dust-sidewinder/f:b3.note: dust sprinkle glitters in the sun; differs from Dust Fang drip

dust-sidewinder/f:u2.note: sand skim is sand-wave ripples; differs from Sideways Skirt shock

dune-racer/f:b3.note: burst of spit mist; differs from Racer Spit drip

dune-racer/f:u1.note: fast fang flick is a jab; differs from Racer Spit drip

beaded-lizard/f:b3.note: oozing chew: slow murky ripples; differs from Venom Chew drip

beaded-lizard/f:u0.note: bead flash: glinting beads, differs from Dodge Roll puff

beaded-lizard/f:u3.note: Won't Let Go: clamped bead studs dig in; differs from Slow Gnaw Hold bite
